request: Add bigger amount of cylindrical holes into the red platforms to decrease their weights. Amount of patterns can be chosen by editor.

actions.operation: Create cylindrical cut holes in the platforms

parameters.quantity: bigger amount (increased number of holes; exact count not specified)
parameters.hole_diameter: not specified (editor to choose; must maintain minimum wall thickness around slot and pin bores)
parameters.cut_depth: through-all (recommended to maximize weight reduction without creating internal trapped cavities)
parameters.hole_axis_direction: normal to platform broad face (±Z direction)

actions.relational_constraint: holes located into the red platforms (material removal from platform bodies); do not intersect the existing rounded-rectangle through-slots or the fixed pivot bores; maintain reasonable edge margin and ligament thickness to preserve stiffness around the pin load paths
actions.unresolved_reference: Hole diameter, exact hole count, and exact keep-out margins are not specified. Holes must avoid: (1) bottom block slot region (SEC01 slot faces 0006/0007/0008/0009), (2) bottom block fixed pivot bore (SEC01 face 0010), (3) top block slot region (SEC02 slot faces 0017/0018/0019/0020), (4) top block fixed pivot bore (SEC02 face 0021). Also confirm if holes are allowed to break into the slot cavity (not recommended) and confirm minimum wall thickness requirement for manufacturing/strength.
steps: Identify the red platforms as the two red base blocks: SEC01 (Bottom base block) and SEC02 (Top base block), per model.json colors and multiview images (front/back/top/bottom).
For SEC01: select the broad planar outer face for sketching the hole layout: face_code 0000 (Block top outer face +Z, Brep_id FACE 62). Start a new sketch on this face.

In the SEC01 sketch, project/convert key edges to create keep-out boundaries: project the slot boundary region associated with slot walls (faces 0006, 0007, 0008, 0009) and the fixed pivot bore center region (bore wall face 0010). Create construction offsets from these projected edges to define a ‘no-hole’ zone around (a) the slot window and (b) the fixed pivot bore area; also offset the external perimeter of the block to maintain an edge margin.

Place one pilot circle (cylindrical hole) center within the remaining safe solid region of SEC01 (area not overlapping the slot and not near the fixed pivot bore). Dimension the circle diameter per editor choice and dimension its position relative to the block edges/centerlines for robust constraint (e.g., symmetric about the block mid-plane in Y for the block, and positioned in X away from the slot ends and away from the fixed-pivot region). Constrain the circle center with horizontal/vertical dimensions to stable references (outer edges or datum planes).

Finish the sketch and create an Extrude-Cut (Pocket) of the circle profile with end condition = Through All in ±Z (cutting through the full block thickness in Z). Verify the cut does not intersect the slot cavity or fixed pivot bore; adjust location/diameter if interference is detected.
For SEC02: repeat the same operation on the top block by selecting face_code 0011 (Block top outer face +Z, Brep_id FACE 101). Start a new sketch on face 0011.

In the SEC02 sketch, project/convert the slot boundary region (faces 0017, 0018, 0019, 0020) and the fixed pivot bore location (face 0021). Create the same style of keep-out offsets and edge margins used on SEC01 to preserve strength around the kinematic interfaces.

Place a matching pilot circle (same diameter and same relative constraints where appropriate) and perform an Extrude-Cut Through All in ±Z on SEC02. Confirm symmetry/consistency between the hole placement on SEC01 and SEC02, since the mechanism appears approximately symmetric in the multiview images and model description.

actions.operation: Pattern/array the cylindrical holes to increase their count

parameters.pattern_type: linear (rectangular) pattern on the platform broad face (recommended); alternative: fill pattern within a boundary if available
parameters.pattern_directions: along platform X and Y directions on the selected face plane
parameters.spacing: not specified (editor to choose; must preserve minimum ligaments and avoid slot/pin regions)

actions.target: the cylindrical holes created in the previous action on the red platforms
actions.relational_constraint: pattern distributes multiple holes on the red platforms; resulting patterned holes must remain within safe solid regions of SEC01 and SEC02 and must not break into: bottom/top slots or fixed pivot bores; maintain edge margin and structural ligaments along load paths from corner pins into the blocks
actions.unresolved_reference: Select exact pattern type (rectangular vs fill), counts, spacings, and extents/boundary limits. Confirm whether pattern should be identical on both platforms (recommended for balance) and whether holes must be symmetric about the block centerlines. Confirm required minimum ligament thickness and any manufacturing constraints (e.g., drill tool access, minimum hole-to-hole spacing).
steps: For SEC01: select the newly created cylindrical cut feature (the through-all hole cut created from the sketch on face_code 0000).

Create a Linear/Rectangular Pattern of the cut feature on SEC01, using the face plane axes as pattern directions: Direction 1 along the block length (X direction) and Direction 2 along the block height (Y direction).

Set pattern counts and spacings as chosen by the editor (‘bigger amount’), but constrain the pattern extents so all instances stay outside the keep-out zones: (a) do not intersect the slot (faces 0006/0007/0008/0009 region), (b) do not intersect the fixed pivot bore (face 0010 region), and (c) maintain an outer edge margin from the block perimeter faces.

If the CAD system supports it, define a boundary (selection of sketch boundary or a construction rectangle) limiting the pattern to the safe region; otherwise, manually adjust counts/spacing until no patterned instance clashes with the slot window or pivot bore and acceptable wall thickness remains.

For SEC02: repeat the same patterning process on the corresponding hole cut feature created from the sketch on face_code 0011. Use identical counts/spacings where feasible to keep both platforms balanced and visually consistent in the multiview appearance.

Regenerate and validate: ensure no patterned holes intersect the slot features (SEC02 faces 0017/0018/0019/0020) or fixed pivot bore (SEC02 face 0021), and confirm that the remaining material around the pin load paths (near the right-end fixed pivot region and near the slot end regions) remains sufficient for stiffness and bearing load transfer.

intention: Decrease the weight of the red platforms (SEC01 and SEC02 base blocks) by removing material with an increased number of patterned cylindrical through-holes while preserving the functional slot guidance and fixed pivot bearing regions.
